style: Flat colours only, every colour drawn with at most one or two hard-edged shade levels, clear dark outlines around every shape, simple flat background. No text, no letters, no signature, no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly or paper texture, no photorealism.

images.prompt: Anime cel-shaded illustration of a young woman knight standing full body, short red hair, light silver armour over a blue tunic, holding a sword point-down, bold tapered black ink lines, bright saturated palette, plain pale background.
Western TV cartoon style drawing of a cheerful orange fox jumping over a log beside a mushroom, thick uniform black outlines, flat bright colours, a simple green meadow and blue sky behind.

Manga-style close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of a teenage boy with messy black hair in a navy blue school uniform jacket with a black collar and white shirt, bold black inking with heavy solid blacks, dark-heavy palette, one flat shadow tone on skin.

Children's picture book flat vector illustration of a cosy kitchen interior with a grandmother baking at a table, shelves with jars, a window and a sleeping cat, thin uniform dark brown outlines, muted earthy palette.

1930s rubber-hose cartoon of a smiling round jalopy car with big eyes driven by a cheerful bean-shaped character in white gloves, bouncing along a road, black ink outlines, limited muted palette of cream, red and olive.
Chibi style group scene of four tiny big-headed friends having a picnic on a blanket with a basket and sandwiches, clean thin dark outlines, light pastel palette with pink, mint and lavender.

Flat-shaded video game key art (not pixel art) of a wide valley landscape with a small adventurer figure with a backpack on a path, a few big rounded hills, a handful of simple trees and a castle in the distance, clean dark outlines, large areas of solid flat colour with one hard-edged shadow tone, no soft shading.
images.replaces: An earlier prompt without the last clause ('Flat-shaded video game key art (not pixel art) of a wide valley landscape with a small adventurer figure with a backpack on a path, hills, trees and a castle in the distance, clean dark outlines, flat cel-shaded colours.') gave an image with soft gradient shading over its hills (11.5% of the image soft variation away from edges, against at most 4% for the others); it was discarded.
